title: Choose the habits dashboard layout
question: Which arrangement makes the daily check-in and long-term consistency easiest to read? All options keep the dark MapaBit canvas, warm bronze activity, and existing habit controls.

options.label: Daily Desk
options.thesis: Today's check-in leads; the year of consistency follows beneath it.
options.viewport: A compact masthead and live totals lead into today's habit actions; each 365-day heatmap sits directly below its habit.
options.risk: History starts lower on the page, so the daily action must stay compact.

regions.label: Your habits title and add action

options.label: Heatmap Ledger
options.thesis: The heatmaps are the index; every habit's action sits beside its history.
options.viewport: A narrow title and summary lead into full-width habit rows, each pairing the 365-day contribution grid with its log control.
options.risk: The year grid is dense on a phone, so it needs its own horizontal scroll area.

regions.label: Shared annual heatmap ledger by habit
Today actions aligned to habit rows

options.label: Habit Field Notes
options.lineage: A working notebook with one tab per ongoing practice
options.thesis: Each habit gets a distinct, readable record with its own activity trace.
options.viewport: A two-column desktop spread of compact habit panels; each panel puts name and action above a scaled annual grid, stacking on mobile.
options.case: Separates habits clearly and makes the dashboard easy to scan when the list grows.
options.risk: Per-habit panels use more vertical space than a unified ledger.
